verdict.rationale: Dover is an ATS with a careers page, so application-form customization is a fair question for it. However, the evidence covers only AI-generated or API-hosted careers pages and AI applicant scoring. Nothing documents custom application questions, knockout/disqualification rules, or compliant EEOC/demographic collection. AI scoring is a different feature from knockout rules and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
